Description:
Hello! Its my first ever mod and pixel art, which was born out of the burning desire to marry Tobirama Senju in Stardew Valley.

The installation requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Clothes for SDVE[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]main SDVE[/url] foldures, just drag what's inside the "Tobirama Senju" and replace the files!

(but i won't refuse help if anyone is willing to help me with coding stuff to change his name in game..)
